title: Living with arranger Bob Sylvester
summary: Duerr lived with Bob Sylvester and his singer wife in New York; Allen links him to Pop Foster.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Do you remember Bob Sylvester? Oh God, yeah. I lived with him. Oh yeah? Yeah, him and his wife for a while I lived with him. Where is he now? I don't know. I lost track of him entirely when I left New York. He probably stayed around New York a good while after I'd left there. Of course he might have been there when I went back in 39 but I didn't get to see him. Yeah, I lived with Bob and his wife. She was singing, she had a singing, a singing program on one of the stations there and Bob was struggling along trying to make arrangements. He used to always, they used to say he used to steal arrangements but I don't know whether they'd think. No, the guy could arrange I believe, you know, because I've seen, I lived with him and I've seen him sitting down writing stuff, scoring stuff out, you know what I mean? But a lot of the guys would say he used to copy the ring of somebody. Maybe he did, I don't know. But he was a hell of a nice guy.
Yeah, I think Pop Foster knew him well.
Pop Foster knew him? Yeah, he knew a lot of guys from down there. Yeah, he used to talk about New Orleans. But where was he from originally? I don't know if anybody could find out.
McCall Plantation, right up the river. He was that where he was from? Yeah, and he used to live here.
Well yeah, that's how I come to... Yeah, well you... But I didn't know you had to win. You were from somewhere down here but I didn't know where.

Yeah, well all those guys, you see Paul Barberin and Louis Russell and Pop Foster and Red Allen and Albert Nicholas and all those guys were with Louis Russell and Louis Armstrong, you know, and the band, the same band. And I'm sure you knew them all around New York at one time or another, you knew Pop.
